declarations.name: IsEnv/common_stage/isEnv_econs/isEnv_base
declarations.scope: Ordinary set-structure semantics: ZFAxioms plus Regular and the displayed powerset existence premise. IsEnv is over some ordinal L-stage; common-stage monotonicity extends any such environment by any constructible element. A constant environment at omega is functional and lies over a stage containing omega.

declarations.name: peelG_provable/finG_provable
declarations.scope: Fixed standard derivations in templTheory8/arG and templTheory1/arF, from semantic validity in arbitrary ZF models. They do not assume hSchema or arbitrary-length matching existence.

declarations.name: pVal
declarations.scope: Internal code for forall t, not(Env(t) and M_k(t)) or X. Its Sigma1 function instance and PF conversions support represented proof induction.

declarations.name: QXE_free/peel_step
declarations.scope: At arbitrary internal k,p with IsSemiformula1 p, represented proof of pVal(k+1,rel(free p)) gives represented proof of pVal(k,rel(all p)); uses MT_succ, internal generalization and compiled fixed peelG.

declarations.name: free_subst_qVec_fvarVec
declarations.conclusion: free(subst(qVec(fvarVec k))B)=subst(fvarVec(k+1))B. No standardness hypothesis on k,B.

declarations.name: peel
declarations.method: Internal Sigma1 successor induction on i with i<=m, invariant pVal(m-i,rel(subst(fvarVec(m-i))(qqAlls b i))). Initial proof is a fixed external hypothesis; the induction target is represented provability, not an external Nat-indexed proof family.

declarations.name: peel_close
declarations.method: Compile fixed nullary-placeholder finG, identify M0 with functionality, apply to the represented PF proof. No assumption x has no free variables beyond IsFormula, and no standard-code restriction.
